items.title: USN-9122-1: pysha3 vulnerability
items.summary: Nicky Mouha discovered that pysha3 incorrectly handled certain SHA-3 operations, leading to an integer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause pysha3 to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9111-1: Mojolicious vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that the secure_compare function in Mojolicious did not run in constant time when comparing strings of different lengths. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to determine the length of a secret string.

items.title: USN-9109-1: Apache::Session::Browseable vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Apache::Session::Browseable did not verify the certificates of remote LDAP servers by default. items.title: USN-9107-1: joblib vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that joblib evaluated the pre_dispatch parameter of the Parallel class as Python code. If an application passed untrusted input to this parameter, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9103-1: HTMLDOC vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that HTMLDOC incorrectly handled certain malformed URIs. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted HTML file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause HTMLDOC to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

items.title: USN-9101-1: Apache Groovy vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that Apache Groovy incorrectly handled the deserialization of MethodClosure objects. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service. (CVE-2015-3253) It was discovered that Apache Groovy incorrectly handled serialization mechanisms.

items.title: USN-9099-1: Eterm vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Eterm incorrectly handled certain escape sequences. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code if a user displayed specially crafted text in the terminal.
